page_title: BHA 0-4 MCI | Brighton v Manchester City 25/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+4' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Jason Steele is alert and denies him with a nice save.
90+3' Valentin Barco (Brighton) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+3' Simon Adingra (Brighton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+2' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
89' Igor (Brighton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jarred Gillett no option but to blow his whistle.
88' The Manchester City players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
85' Golden opportunity! Joao Pedro (Brighton) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
85' A crossfield pass from Jason Steele (Brighton) fails to find any of his teammates.
83' Simon Adingra (Brighton) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
82' Valentin Barco (Brighton) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
79' A substitution has been made. Kyle Walker is replaced by Rico Lewis (Manchester City).
79' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sergio Gomez (Manchester City) replacing Rodri.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) comes onto the pitch for Bernardo Silva.
76' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) has received a yellow card for his foul.
75' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Danny Welbeck and he is replaced by Mark O'Mahony (Brighton).
75' Fine play by Danny Welbeck (Brighton) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
73' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but Jason Steele comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kevin De Bruyne.
71' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Phil Foden will be replaced by Jack Grealish (Manchester City).
71' Referee Jarred Gillett signals NO PENALTY for Brighton after a VAR review!
70' PENALTY APPEAL by Brighton, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
69' Joao Pedro (Brighton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
66' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
66' Dangerous play by Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton). Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Simon Adingra (Brighton) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
62' 0 - 4 Goal! Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:4.
60' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
60' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

59' That didn't go as planned! Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Jason Steele, who easily kept it out.
59' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' Simon Adingra (Brighton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
56' The game has come to an end for Jakub Moder. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Igor (Brighton).
53' Joao Pedro (Brighton) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Ederson makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.
53' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester City comes to nothing.
52' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Manchester City, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' The linesman raises his flag. Simon Adingra (Brighton) is adjudged offside.
46' Good clearance! Pascal Gross (Brighton) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
46' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Odeluga Offiah (Brighton) replaces Joel Veltman.
46' The manager makes a subsitution with Simon Adingra (Brighton) coming on for Adam Lallana.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45+2' Some patient build-up play from Manchester City as they look to unlock the defence.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Phil Foden (Manchester City) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
45' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
41' Joao Pedro (Brighton) picks up a long through ball, but Ederson deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
39' Flag up against Danny Welbeck (Brighton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
38' Jakub Moder (Brighton) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
35' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Joel Veltman (Brighton) for a tough tackle.
34' 0 - 3 Goal! Phil Foden (Manchester City) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
31' A pass from Kyle Walker (Manchester City) is intercepted by Jason Steele and the move breaks down.
29' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Joao Pedro (Brighton), but the defence gets it clear.
28' Phil Foden (Manchester City) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
26' 0 - 2 Goal! The free-kick is fired in by Phil Foden (Manchester City) and the ball inadvertently flicks off a defender and spins into the net, leaving Jason Steele stranded. 0:2.

25' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle after Lewis Dunk (Brighton) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Manchester City earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
23' The resulting corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
23' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
20' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.

19' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
19' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brighton.
19' Jakub Moder (Brighton) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
17' 0 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Kyle Walker is pounced on by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City). His close-range strike flashes past Jason Steele and into the top right corner. 0:1.
15' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort just over the crossbar!
14' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. A free kick to Manchester City.
13' Ederson (Manchester City) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
11' Manchester City keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
8' Ederson (Manchester City) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

6' Adam Lallana (Brighton) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
5' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Ederson pulls off a great save to deny Danny Welbeck (Brighton), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
2' Manchester City keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' The first half has just begun.
Manchester City will kick the game off.
Jarred Gillett will referee today's match.
